name: GSMIV — USB capture and source transition check (10 V)
notes: Connect OWON only to the upstream external input and 2281S only to BAT; disconnect the real battery. Use m5stack-fire-power-validation (awake), USB telemetry at 115200, and start with both outputs off. 10 V is the operator-confirmed external voltage. The external source uses the operator-requested 3 A startup/recovery limit. Battery discharge 2 A and protection 2.5 A remain editable starting assumptions, not confirmed bench limits. Review wiring and these values before running. Select a suitable 2281S battery model in simulator mode with range covering 3.10–3.95 V; retain its model resistance and record it. This sequence selects STATIC simulation. VOC is not loaded terminal VBAT. 15 s settle/60 s capture are provisional; inspect drift and extend as needed. Logging continues during all phases. End/abort attempts source OFF and leaves the battery in its current state; it does not guarantee power if communication or instrument protection fails. Pause holds settings and continues logging. DMM/shunt references and oscilloscope remain required for formal qualification. First-run connection and polarity check; this is not release qualification.

steps.label: Set external supply to confirmed 10 V
External startup current limit — 3 A for inrush headroom
Use static battery model for repeatable plateaus
Battery discharge limit — review 2 A starting value
Battery voltage protection for deployed 4.20 V charger
Power DUT from simulated battery; allow boot
Weak-source capture; current is not commanded battery current
Remove external source; retain simulated battery
